prompt: Implement Shipping module in Lombok+Spring project with facade pattern

assertions.name: correct_package_placement
assertions.description: Classes placed in shipping/domain/ and shipping/application/ sub-packages

assertions.name: facade_pattern_followed
assertions.description: ShippingFacade exists as public class delegating to package-private services

assertions.name: spring_configuration_present
assertions.description: @Configuration class with @Bean methods wiring services like OrderConfiguration/FulfillmentConfiguration

assertions.name: lombok_value_for_vos
assertions.description: ShipmentId, ShippingAddress, TrackingNumber use @Value annotation like OrderId/Money

assertions.name: domain_event_interface_reused
assertions.description: Events implement existing com.example.orders.domain.DomainEvent, not a new interface

assertions.name: pending_events_pattern
assertions.description: Shipment aggregate uses pendingEvents + flushEvents() pattern like Order and Fulfillment

assertions.name: all_building_blocks_present
assertions.description: All 8 building blocks from DesignDoc have corresponding Java classes

assertions.name: business_rules_enforced
assertions.description: dispatch() checks tracking number (rule-2), confirmDelivery checks not already delivered (rule-3)

assertions.name: orderid_reused_not_recreated
assertions.description: Uses import from com.example.orders.domain.OrderId, does not create a new OrderId class
